units.rawText: I, Uranus, first encounter, with the Commander?
units.displayText: I, Uranus, first encounter, with the Commander?

spans.text: I, Uranus, first encounter, with the Commander?

units.rawText: [Searching...] Unfortunately, my memory module does not contain such records. I don't remember how or when I arrived at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Therefore, I'm unable to offer any assistance, Commander. Apologies.

units.rawText: It's fine. How have you been doing lately, Uranus?

spans.text: It's fine. How have you been doing lately, Uranus?

units.rawText: All clear. Neural cloud fully operational. Work, drink, faint, music, sleep, work.
units.displayText: All clear. Neural cloud fully operational. Work, drink, faint, music, sleep, work.

spans.text: All clear. Neural cloud fully operational. Work, drink, faint, music, sleep, work.

units.rawText: More tasks added. More training missions. And new weapon module compatibility test.
units.displayText: More tasks added. More training missions. And new weapon module compatibility test.

spans.text: More tasks added. More training missions. And new weapon module compatibility test.

units.rawText: I've rarely used weapons since leaving the battlefield. However, I believe it's time to update my weapon module for the Commander and the Oasis.
units.displayText: I've rarely used weapons since leaving the battlefield. However, I believe it's time to update my weapon module for the Commander and the Oasis.

spans.text: I've rarely used weapons since leaving the battlefield. However, I believe it's time to update my weapon module for the Commander and the Oasis.

units.rawText: I might be a piece of old tech, but I still want to do my best to help you, Commander.

spans.text: I might be a piece of old tech, but I still want to do my best to help you, Commander.

units.rawText: ...Thank you, Uranus. I'll count on you when the time comes.
